definitions: The action of hitting something repeatedly with a hammer or a similar object.
The action of repeatedly hitting or punching someone or something.
The action of repeatedly and forcefully stating an idea or point.
The action of defeating an opponent very heavily in a contest or game.
examples: The sound of hammering echoed through the street.
He was hammering away at the old nail.
The politician was hammering home his message.
They were hammering the opposition in the final quarter.
